Chapter 6941: Who Are You?

Chapter 6941: Who Are You?

This immortal’s eyes contained the myriad dao and worldly laws.

“Eternal Banish.” The eyes became profound as he chanted a mantra.

They created an abyss of time and space, capable of trapping someone forever. The chaotic forces in there could also grind them to pieces.

Spectators shuddered since they didn’t know if they could block or escape the abyss.

“This is it?” Li Qiye smiled and stared at the attacker.

“Ahh!” Blood gushed out of the attacker’s eyes.

There seemed to have been spears or chains piercing the eyes instantly. This seemed impossible since he had positioned himself outside of the immediate space and time. How did it bypass his defenses?

“Stay.” Li Qiye chanted his own mantra. Despite being imperceptible, it became the reality.

“Pluff!” Invisible spears pierced the immortal’s body, forcing him to scream in agony.

Numerous bloody holes appeared all around him, but there was no sign of weapons or technique.

“What is going on?” Immortals gazed at Li Qiye to no avail.

“What power is this?” The primordial immortal got out of his seat. The only thing he perceived was Li Qiye speaking, nothing more.

This was utterly bizarre. He could have killed a grand immortal in the blink of an eye. However, this still required him to use his dao or a technique.

Treasure Immortal Lord’s expression became ugly. He felt danger in this unprecedented crisis.

“Who are you?!” He shouted.

“Just a passerby, but currently, your killer.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Dao Brother, we can talk.” Treasure staggered ever so slightly upon hearing this, clearly intimidated.

“It’s over for talking, I will take my maids back on top of killing your branch.” Li Qiye said.

Everyone exchanged glances upon finding the truth. So the kidnapped girls belonged to this mortal.

Treasure had truly messed up, kidnapping this unfathomable master’s servants. He cursed Perpetual Immortal for giving them to him.

Out of all the women in this world, the guy picked the worst ones possible.
